raw.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(unit_price_eur), 2) AS total_revenue_eur FROM luxexperience.order_items GROUP BY category

results.question: What share of total GMV came from orders that were returned?

raw.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.gmv_eur ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.gmv_eur), 0), 2) AS returned_gmv_share FROM luxexperience.orders o

guarded.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.gmv_eur ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.gmv_eur), 0), 2) AS returned_gmv_share FROM luxexperience.orders o

ontology.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN returned_orders.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN o.gmv_eur ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.gmv_eur), 0), 2) AS returned_gmv_share FROM luxexperience.orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM luxexperience.order_items WHERE returned = True) returned_orders ON o.order_id = returned_orders.order_id

ontology_guarded.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN returned_orders.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN o.gmv_eur ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(o.gmv_eur), 0), 2) AS returned_gmv_share FROM luxexperience.orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT order_id FROM luxexperience.order_items WHERE returned = True) returned_orders ON o.order_id = returned_orders.order_id

results.question: What is the total item revenue in EUR by sales channel?

raw.sql:
SELECT
  T1.channel,
  ROUND(SUM(T2.unit_price_eur), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM luxexperience.orders AS T1
JOIN luxexperience.order_items AS T2
  ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id
GROUP BY
  T1.channel

guarded.sql:
SELECT
  T1.channel,
  ROUND(SUM(T2.unit_price_eur), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM luxexperience.orders AS T1
JOIN luxexperience.order_items AS T2
  ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id
GROUP BY
  T1.channel

ontology.sql:
SELECT
  T2.channel,
  ROUND(SUM(T1.unit_price_eur), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM luxexperience.order_items AS T1
INNER JOIN luxexperience.orders AS T2
  ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id
GROUP BY
  T2.channel

ontology_guarded.sql:
SELECT
  T2.channel,
  ROUND(SUM(T1.unit_price_eur), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM luxexperience.order_items AS T1
INNER JOIN luxexperience.orders AS T2
  ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id
GROUP BY
  T2.channel

results.question: For each platform, what is the average order value in EUR and the average number of items per order?

raw.sql: SELECT o.platform, ROUND(SUM(o.gmv_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value, ROUND(COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM luxexperience.orders o JOIN luxexperience.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.platform

guarded.sql: SELECT o.platform, ROUND(SUM(o.gmv_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value, ROUND(COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM luxexperience.orders o JOIN luxexperience.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.platform

ontology.sql:
SELECT
  o.platform,
  ROUND(SUM(o.gmv_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value_eur,
  ROUND(COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM luxexperience.orders AS o
JOIN luxexperience.order_items AS oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY
  o.platform

ontology_guarded.sql:
SELECT
  o.platform,
  ROUND(SUM(o.gmv_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_order_value_eur,
  ROUND(COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS avg_items_per_order
FROM luxexperience.orders AS o
JOIN luxexperience.order_items AS oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
GROUP BY
  o.platform
